title: Artifact gateway with compatibility matrix and safe pin
creator: Aisha Khatri
description: We need a resilient end-to-end artifact admission pipeline that validates new open-source LLM weights, converts them into runtime-optimized artifacts, computes a compatibility score against our kernel matrix, runs deterministic smoke/quality checks, and only then creates a pin + publishes a performance profile to the model catalog. The goal is to reduce manual triage for model onboarding while making automated rollbacks safe and auditable.
tasks: Design artifact gateway contract (S3/HF/OCI sources, checksums, provenance headers)
Implement compatibility matrix service (cpu/gpu/quantization support grid)
Add pre-conversion validation: shape checks, dtype sanity, metadata extraction, license parsing
Create deterministic conversion worker with idempotent outputs and stable names
Build smoke validation harness: latency smoke, sample generation, embedding similarity tests
Auto-generate pin suggestion and publish draft profile to model catalog (with audit trail)
Rollback and safety net: mark pins as canary/auto-fallback and provide automated unpin on regression
Integrate with console: pipeline run view, failure reasons, and operator retry hooks
acceptance_criteria: New weight uploads trigger a pipeline run and produce an immutable artifact ID
Compatibility matrix returns a clear PASS/WARN/FAIL recommendation for each runtime target
Conversion step is deterministic: same input weights produce same artifact checksum across runs
Smoke validation produces a scorecard (latency, perplexity surrogate, embedding drift) and blocks pin on major regressions
Pin creation must include provenance metadata and link to the published performance profile
Operator can trigger safe rollback which demotes pin and routes traffic to previous pinned variant
Audit logs capture user, timestamps, SHA checksums, and PR/drive links for the decision path
